instant.$description: No animation - respects prefers-reduced-motion or truly instant state changes.

fast.$description: Micro-interactions: button/link hover and active state changes.

base.$description: Default duration for most UI transitions: fades, color/background changes.

moderate.$description: Larger surface transitions: dropdown/tooltip open, accordion expand/collapse.

slow.$description: Full-surface transitions: modal/dialog and off-canvas enter/exit.

slower.$description: Large, attention-directing motion used sparingly (page-level banners).

linear.$description: Constant speed - progress indicators and marquee-style motion only.

standard.$description: Default easing for transitions that both enter and exit the screen.

decelerate.$description: Entering elements: fast start, gentle finish (menus, dialogs, tooltips appearing).

accelerate.$description: Exiting elements: gentle start, fast finish (menus, dialogs, tooltips dismissing).

fade.$description: Fade transitions for tooltips, toasts, and simple show/hide states.

overlay.$description: Modal, dialog, and off-canvas enter/exit transitions.

collapse.$description: Accordion, dropdown, and collapsible-panel expand/collapse transitions.
